'''Robann Potannin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Humanoid/Legends|Humanoid]] who served as a [[Soldier/Legends|Soldier]] in the [[Senate Security Officer|Senate Security]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. Potannin was the leader of a six-soldier unit assigned to protect [[Ula Vii]], who had been appointed envoy to a [[Hutt Cartel/Legends|Hutt Cartel]]. He was [[Death/Legends|killed]] when he was shot in the eye by a [[Fastbreeder|hex droid]] during the [[skirmish in Tassaa Bareesh's palace]].

==Biography==
After the Messenger Vii had retired to his room on [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]], Potannin informed him that he had received invitations from various people in the palace. When Vii met with [[Jet Nebula]] in a cantina, Potannin and his squad were stunned by the [[Mandalorian/Legends|Mandalorian]] [[Dao Stryver]] who was here to capture Nebula. Eventually, Potannin and his squad were carried by soldiers and palace guards in [[Tassaa Bareesh]]'s palace. When [[Larin Moxla]] and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Shigar Konshi]] stormed in the palace and killed the [[Houk/Legends|Houk]] guards, Potannin regained consciousness and told them what had happened after Stryver escaped. Near the main vault, Robann and his squad witnessed Konshi dueling [[Eldon Ax]]. Before they could support the Jedi, they were ambushed [[Fastbreeder|hex droids]] that climbed from the main vault. Potannin and his squad armed themselves with sniper rifles to take the well-armored droids under fire, but the sergeant was hit by a stray bullet in the eye and died.
